mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_meeting_tracking_item (creator_id, meeting_id, workflow_run_id, stage_run_id, source_type, item_type, title, description, status, owner_type, owner_ref, reopen_trigger, required_for_continue, reopen_policy, auto_refresh_enabled, refresh_mode, refresh_interval_hours, watch_query, watch_scope, next_check_at, last_checked_at, last_check_status, last_check_note, last_check_fingerprint, change_severity, due_at, last_update_at, closed_at) VALUES (#{creatorId}, #{meetingId}, #{workflowRunId}, #{stageRunId}, #{sourceType}, #{itemType}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerRef}, #{reopenTrigger}, #{requiredForContinue}, #{reopenPolicy}, #{autoRefreshEnabled}, #{refreshMode}, #{refreshIntervalHours}, #{watchQuery}, #{watchScope}, #{nextCheckAt}, #{lastCheckedAt}, #{lastCheckStatus}, #{lastCheckNote}, #{lastCheckFingerprint}, #{changeSeverity}, #{dueAt}, #{lastUpdateAt}, #{closedAt})

INSERT INTO ai_meeting_tracking_item (creator_id, meeting_id, workflow_run_id, stage_run_id, source_type, item_type, title, description, status, owner_type, owner_ref, reopen_trigger, required_for_continue, reopen_policy, auto_refresh_enabled, refresh_mode, refresh_interval_hours, watch_query, watch_scope, next_check_at, last_checked_at, last_check_status, last_check_note, last_check_fingerprint, change_severity, due_at, last_update_at, closed_at) VALUES
(#{item.creatorId}, #{item.meetingId}, #{item.workflowRunId}, #{item.stageRunId}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.itemType}, #{item.title}, #{item.description}, #{item.status}, #{item.ownerType}, #{item.ownerRef}, #{item.reopenTrigger}, #{item.requiredForContinue}, #{item.reopenPolicy}, #{item.autoRefreshEnabled}, #{item.refreshMode}, #{item.refreshIntervalHours}, #{item.watchQuery}, #{item.watchScope}, #{item.nextCheckAt}, #{item.lastCheckedAt}, #{item.lastCheckStatus}, #{item.lastCheckNote}, #{item.lastCheckFingerprint}, #{item.changeSeverity}, #{item.dueAt}, #{item.lastUpdateAt}, #{item.closedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_meeting_tracking_item WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} ORDER BY gmt_create DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM ai_meeting_tracking_item ORDER BY COALESCE(next_check_at, gmt_create) ASC, id DESC

SELECT * FROM ai_meeting_tracking_item WHERE auto_refresh_enabled = 1 AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'REJECTED')) AND (next_check_at IS NULL OR next_check_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_check_at, gmt_create) ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM ai_meeting_tracking_item WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND title = #{title} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_meeting_tracking_item SET status = #{status}, last_update_at = #{lastUpdateAt}, closed_at = #{closedAt}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_meeting_tracking_item SET next_check_at = #{nextCheckAt}, last_checked_at = #{lastCheckedAt}, last_check_status = #{lastCheckStatus}, last_check_note = #{lastCheckNote}, last_check_fingerprint = #{lastCheckFingerprint}, change_severity = #{changeSeverity}, last_update_at = #{lastUpdateAt}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
